items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: And I met Wild Bill Davison, who I later toured with, Lou McGarrity, Cutty Cutshall, Eddie Con — I mean all the guys. And I got to play with them.

ctx.x: I’m not familiar with him I’m sorry to say.

Oh what an unbelievable player. But anyway he said, “I like the way you play,” he said, “you know” he says, “I go to this Manassas Jazz Festival up by Washington, DC” and he said, “God all the musicians, I think I could get you on that.” I said, “Well I don’t have any cred to help you.” And he said, “No yeah I can do it.” So by God he got me on that festival. And I met Wild Bill Davison, who I later toured with, Lou McGarrity, Cutty Cutshall, Eddie Con — I mean all the guys. And I got to play with them. I mean…
Pinch me, right? I can’t believe this, alongside with those people.
